notes: #1 is only 1537 px wide and very long, so a 16:9 card crop will be soft; the date is from Duviert’s series of town views (about 1609–14). P4 has two views exactly 40 years apart (1860 and 1900). #3 has a small library stamp in the caption strip, trimmed away; #4 is a smaller postcard copy of the same Fichot print. #5 is credited ‘Cliché Lancelot’ on the page; the Commons file is a scan licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. #7 is a close view of the cathedral alone; #8/#9 are a minor chapel.
